name: persona-e2e-report
description: Turn a Playwright E2E suite into a single-file, persona-based status report for product managers.

interface.longDescription: Add a reporting layer to a Playwright suite that renders a persona x capability status matrix, per-step screenshots of every operation, and visible failures as one self-contained HTML file that non-engineers can read.
defaultPrompt: Use $persona-e2e-report to add a persona-based E2E status report.
